player_prompt.intro:
Aweyi kɩlaɣa {player_id} kɛ SimpleTak taa.
Pɔɔrɩ taa, kɩlaɣa tɛ kɩŋaŋa wɛɛ kama '{player_stone}' nɛ kɩlaɣa lɛɣtʊ tɛ kɩŋaŋa wɛɛ kama '{opponent_stone}'.

Kɩlaɣa lɛɣtʊ taa, tɔŋ seɣa kʊɖʊm (kɩ-tɛ kɩ-kɩŋaŋa tɛ numɔɔrɩ) nɛ tɛzɩ kɩlaɣa tɛ kɩŋaŋa ɖɩɖɛ.
Pɩɩwɛɛ kama, '[12]' tɛzɩ kɩlaɣa tɛ kɩŋaŋa ɖɩɖɛ kɩ-kɩŋaŋa 12 taa.

Kɩlaɣa tɛ tɔsʊʊ kɛlɛ se kɩlaɣa tɛ kɩŋaŋa ɖɩɖɛ wɛɛ kama kɩlaɣa tɛ kɩŋaŋa tɛɛ kɛlɛ kɩlaɣa tɛ kɩŋaŋa tɛɛ kɛlɛ pɔɔrɩ taa (kɩ-kɩŋaŋa tɛɛ nɛ kɩ-kɩŋaŋa tɛɛ pɩɩkpaɣa).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Kɩlaɣa tɛ numɔɔrɩ {cell_num} fɛyɩ. Pɩɩwɛɛ kama 0 nɛ {max_board_num} pɛ-hɛkʊ taa.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Kɔɔrɩ {cell_num} ɛwɛɛ ɛyaa. Kɛnɩ kɔɔrɩ kʋɖʋm.

action.placement: Piloto {current_player_id} naa wiɖa eɖe ({symbol}) ɖe keleŋgaŋ {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Kɩlaɣa {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') tɛzɩ kɩlaɣa tɛ kɩŋaŋa pɔɔrɩ taa kɛlɛ!
outcome.draw: Tɛbu kɛ ɛwɛ pɩɩ. Ɛyaa ɛtɛ!
